Subject: Interest in Redwood — request for evaluation/MAP and expected commit volumes

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — Storix's search and recommendations team liked the latency profile and the KV-cache savings you showed. We want to move from an exploratory eval into a formal mutual action plan (MAP) so we can present a clear timeline to leadership and procurement.

High level asks from our side:
- A 6-week evaluation playbook we can run (success criteria + sample prompts)
- Proposed monthly token/TPM targets post-eval (we're modeling production traffic in month 1–6)
- Pricing brackets tied to commit milestones and a list of discount triggers (e.g., committed TPM thresholds, annualized volume)
- Any security/integration prerequisites for procurement to sign off (SOC 2 evidence, data residency notes)

Can you send a draft MAP and a proposed ramp schedule by early next week? Procurement will want raw numbers to start the SOW/PO conversation.

Elaine Park

Storix Solutions

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Elaine Park <elaine@storix.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood — request for evaluation/MAP and expected commit volumes

Hi Elaine — great to hear the demo landed. Attached is a first-pass evaluation playbook (JLR-eval-playbook.pdf) and a companion spreadsheet with a proposed monthly volume trajectory (Storix-MAP-draft-v2.xlsx). High-level summary below so procurement has something to review quickly.

Evaluation (6 weeks) — success criteria
- Week 1: Integration & smoke tests (embedding pipeline + inference calls)
- Weeks 2–4: Load-based QA (latency P95 under 250ms on dev replica, regression tests on top prompts)
- Weeks 5–6: UAT with a 10% traffic shadow and quality signoff from search team

Proposed post-eval committed trajectory (tokens/month / TPM target):
- Month 1: 75M tokens (avg TPM 3.0M) — pilot pricing applies
- Month 2: 180M tokens (avg TPM 6.0M) — step-up to committed bracket A
- Month 3–4: 350M tokens (avg TPM 11.6M) — committed bracket B
- Month 5–6: 700M tokens (avg TPM 23.3M) — committed bracket C + optional burst capacity

Pricing & discount triggers (draft):
- Pilot bracket: pay-as-you-go at listed hosted rates for month 1
- Bracket A (>=180M/mo): 12% discount on hosted list
- Bracket B (>=350M/mo): 20% discount + 1% credit for latency SLOs met
- Bracket C (>=700M/mo): 28% discount + dedicated capacity uplift options and a usage rebate if 6-month aggregate >=3.5B tokens

Open items for procurement: SOC 2 Type II report, standard DPA, and a slot for a short security posture call. I flagged those in the attachments and added a HubSpot link for the commercial record.

Next steps I propose:
1) Storix reviews attachments and replies with any adjustments to TPM targets or trial dates by Wed (17 Sep).
2) We lock the MAP and draft a short SOW for procurement to review (we can surface a redline-friendly DocuSign link).
3) If agreed, we begin integration week starting Mon 22 Sep.

Attaching: JLR-eval-playbook.pdf (playbook), Storix-MAP-draft-v2.xlsx (trajectory + pricing cells).

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0134

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Evaluation playbook + proposed monthly volume trajectory

Jasmine / Ben — quick note from pricing: the discount tiers Jasmine proposed look reasonable, but procurement may push for earlier tier credits tied to a 3-month ramp vs. the 6-month plan. Suggest we prepare a counter that accelerates Bracket B to Month 3 if Storix commits to a minimum 3-month aggregate of 650M tokens. Also recommend carving out a temporary buffer for KV-cache sizing (anticipate ~10% over initial TPM in first 30 days).

Proposed language for MAP (two small edits):
- Operational SLA: P95 inference latency under 300ms for pilot cluster; if not met, a one-time credit of 2% of monthly invoice applies.
- Early-acceleration clause: if Storix increases committed TPM by >=40% month-over-month for two consecutive months before month 4, we will reprice to the next bracket retroactively and issue an invoice credit.

Ben — can you confirm capacity availability for a mid-September integration (22 Sep start) and whether we can guarantee the pilot slot?

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Thanks — this is helpful. Procurement and I reviewed the playbook and the trajectory spreadsheet. A couple of asks before we lock the MAP:

1) Can we shift the initial TPM target up by ~20% in Month 2 (so Month 2 target becomes 216M tokens) if we commit to Bracket A pricing? Our business has a seasonal load spike in week 3 of month 2 and we need the headroom.

2) Procurement requests the SOC 2 artifact and a one-hour security session next week. They also asked for a simple two-line indemnity clarification in the SOW regarding model outputs and customer data.

If you can confirm capacity for the higher Month 2 TPM and attach the SOC 2 link, we can sign the MAP and route the SOW to procurement for a PO.

Elaine Park
Director, Search & ML Platforms
Storix Solutions
